ถนนในชนบท (Rural road in Thailand): A two-lane asphalt road seen at eye level from mid-lane, running from the foreground and bending slightly left into the distance. The grey surface has a faded, dashed yellow centre line. Low concrete kerbs edge both sides, with dry brown dirt and sparse grass verges beyond. On the right, concrete utility poles carry many overhead power lines, and one tall curved street lamp stands at right front. On the left, a black-and-white striped post with a small Thai flag stands near the kerb, and more poles recede into the distance. Mid-distance on the right are dark wooden houses, at least one raised on posts; low buildings stand among trees on the left. Trees line both sides; one palm in the distance. The sky is pale, hazy grey-blue with flat daylight; time of day unclear. No vehicles or people clearly visible.
